def: a musical piece or song to be accompanied by an instrument

occurrences.text: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.
Take thou away from me the noise of thy songs; for I will not hear the melody of thy viols.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
